The University of Melbourne - Professor Maurice H Belz Scholarships 2022 is an initiative by the University of Melbourne, Australia for master's students (Mathematics and Statistics). This scholarship aims to support students undertaking research in the area of Statistics, Applied Probability, Stochastic Processes or Operations Research. The selected candidates will receive financial support of up to AUD 7,000.
To be eligible, an applicant must -
Be a Masters's student in the School of Mathematics and Statistics undertaking research in the area of statistics, applied probability, stochastic processes or operations research
The selected candidates will receive a single payment of up to AUD 7,000

The candidates will be made on academic merit, determined by third-year weighted average marks (or equivalent).
Scholarships will only be taken up after enrolment in the Master's of Science (Mathematics & Statistics) is complete, and will not be offered in conjunction with other school scholarships.
The selection committee reserves the right to not offer a scholarship or to award fewer than three scholarships.
